items.raw_excerpt: A freak fish event that 'challenged reactor safety' at Canada's largest nuclear plant shows why the nuclear energy governments are relying on to fight climate change must also become more resilient to it.
items.summary_en: A freak fish event at Bruce Power on Lake Huron challenged reactor safety. Millions of gizzard shad died in warm water and clogged the plant's water intakes. The case shows nuclear plants may need to cope with climate change too.
items.summary_ko: 온타리오 호수 브루스 원자력 발전소에서 기이한 물고기 사건이 냉각수 흡입구를 막으며 안전을 위협했다.
items.title_en: Millions of fish hit Canada's biggest nuclear plant

items.title_original: Millions of fish tested Canada's largest nuclear plant. The incident points to a growing climate risk

items.raw_excerpt: A record number of people have gained German citizenship in Berlin since the last elections in 2023. We look at how many people could go to the polls for the first time – and at what they might want to know when they get there.
items.summary_en: A record number of people became German citizens in Berlin after the 2023 elections. Many of them can vote for the first time in the Berlin elections. The article explains what new voters may want to know before they go to the polls.
items.summary_ko: 2023년 선거 이후 베를린에서 역대 최대 수의 사람이 독일 시민권을 받았다. 이들 중 많은 사람이 베를린 선거에서 처음으로 투표할 수 있다. 기사는 새 유권자들이 투표소에 가기 전 알아두면 좋을 내용을 설명한다.
items.title_en: New German citizens can vote in Berlin elections
items.title_ko: 베를린 선거, 새 시민들 처음으로 투표
items.title_original: How many new German citizens can vote in the Berlin elections?

items.raw_excerpt: Nearly two of the four flu vaccines ordered for Switzerland for the 2026/2027 influenza season are facing delivery delays. Does this mean you could get your shot too late?
items.summary_en: Nearly half of the flu vaccines ordered for Switzerland for the 2026/2027 season may arrive late. Two of the four ordered shots are facing delivery delays. It is not yet clear whether people will get their shots too late.
items.summary_ko: 스위스가 2026/2027 절기용으로 주문한 독감 백신 네 종 가운데 두 종이 납기 지연을 겪고 있다. 그 절반가량이 제때 도착하지 못할 수 있다. 주사 시기가 늦어질지 여부는 아직 불확실하다.
items.title_en: Will delays leave Switzerland short of flu vaccines this winter?

items.title_original: Will delays mean Switzerland lacks enough flu vaccines this winter?

items.raw_excerpt: Starting a family is a dream for many, regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity. SO what are your options if you want to start a family as a queer person?
items.summary_en: A guide explains the options for queer people who want to start a family in Austria. It covers the paths available regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

items.summary_en: The mayor of Valencia said the city will give its medal to the people of Ceuta. She also said immigrants should follow the laws and learn Spanish to get nationality. Ceuta is a small Spanish city on the coast of Africa.

items.raw_excerpt: Several Taiwanese beverage chains, including PeakTea and Hachiyo Tea, were among businesses fined for food safety violations in recent government inspections, authorities said Thursday.

items.raw_excerpt: Waterfront homes are collapsing along the coast. Homeowners generally have plenty of warning before their house buckles. So why aren't most houses removed, or at least emptied, before they fall?
